bind_address.description: IP address the ipmiseld daemon will bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port to listen on for incoming connections.

user.description: System user account under which the daemon will run (must exist).

group.description: System group under which the daemon will run (must exist).

device_interface.description: Path to the IPMI device interface (e.g., /dev/ipmi0 or /dev/ipmidev/0).

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for logging (e.g., 'WARNING' logs warnings and above).

log_file.description: Path to log file; use '-' to log to stderr instead.

ipmi_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for IPMI commands.

ipmi_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed IPMI commands.

local_only.description: If enabled, only local (non-network) IPMI communication is used.

auth_enable.description: Enable BMC-side authentication for IPMI sessions (requires valid credentials).

session_timeout.description: Session timeout in seconds for remote IPMI sessions.

snmp_trap_enable.description: Enable forwarding of IPMI system events as SNMP traps.

snmp_trap_destinations.description: List of SNMP trap destinations (host, port, community).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of SNMP trap receiver.

port.description: UDP port of SNMP trap receiver (typically 162).

community.description: SNMP community string (e.g., 'public' or private string).

syslog_enable.description: Enable forwarding of IPMI events to local syslog.

pid_file.description: Path to store the daemon's process ID file.

preload_sdr.description: If enabled, preload Sensor Data Records (SDRs) at startup for faster event decoding.

use_secure_auth.description: Use secure authentication (SHA1 or MD5) instead of plain text (if BMC supports it).

extra_options.description: Additional space-separated command-line options for ipmiseld (advanced use).
